name: Montcada i Reixac (Spain)
description: Red field with two vertical rows of four yellow discs at the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 9 July 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2237 of 31 July 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with two vertical rows each of four yellow discs of diameter 1/6 of the height, with a vertical separation of 1/12 and horizontal of 1/6 of the height.

features.role: two vertical rows of four discs, each 1/6 of the height
